editorial:
Imagine being a junior lawyer just starting your career and getting married to a lovely woman, only to realize your life is about to get very chaotic. You follow Karthik, who works under his uncle and is trying to balance his new marriage with Bhuvana. The vibe is light and funny, but things take a wild turn when Karthik points to a stranger, Radharavi, and tells his new wife that this man is actually his wife. It sounds crazy because it is, and the movie quickly turns into a comedy of errors as you watch Karthik navigate this weird situation. 

What really makes this work is the awkward humor and the way Karthik tries to cover his tracks. While the pacing can be a bit slow in the middle, the funny moments make up for it. You will enjoy the chemistry between the leads and the goofy twists. If you want to experience this one, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a great pick if you just want to turn your brain off and laugh at some silly mistakes.
endingExplained: In the end, it is revealed that Karthik is dealing with a mental health struggle that makes him confused about identities. After a series of funny and stressful mishaps, he gets the help he needs to stabilize his mind. Bhuvana stays supportive throughout the process, showing her love for him. The movie wraps up with Karthik recovering his sanity, fixing his relationship, and finally finding peace in his personal and professional life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves lighthearted Tamil comedies and family dramas.
